failure.invariant: Kind E2E begins only when its checkout and temporary filesystems have at least 12 GiB free and Docker is reachable.
failure.trigger: A host runs an E2E build with insufficient free capacity.
failure.mechanism: Go linker or Docker work consumes the remaining host storage and fails after the expensive E2E setup has started.
failure.impact: The E2E result is infrastructure noise instead of evidence about GoAuthy.

root.cause: E2E entrypoints had no common host-capacity preflight before Go and Docker work.
root.detection_gap: The failure surfaced during linking or image building rather than at target entry.

replay.oracle: The same preflight exits 1 one KiB below the 12 GiB floor and exits 0 exactly at the floor.
